DRUNKENMASTER-INGREDIENT.title: Ingredient
DRUNKENMASTER-INGREDIENT.description: Playing it adds its effect to your [gold]Brew[/gold] instead of doing it now.
DRUNKENMASTER-BREW.title: Brew
DRUNKENMASTER-BREW.description: Your pot of [gold]Ingredients[/gold]. When it is full it seals into a [gold]Concoction[/gold] potion. The pot empties at the end of combat.
DRUNKENMASTER-INTOXICATION.title: Intoxication
DRUNKENMASTER-INTOXICATION.description: Builds as you drink and fades a little each turn. The more you have, the drunker you get: [gold]Sober[/gold], [gold]Tipsy[/gold], [gold]Drunk[/gold], [gold]Blackout[/gold].
DRUNKENMASTER-SOBER.title: Sober
DRUNKENMASTER-TIPSY.title: Tipsy
DRUNKENMASTER-TIPSY.description: [blue]4[/blue] or more [gold]Intoxication[/gold]. You have [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold] and [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Dexterity[/gold] while Tipsy or above.
DRUNKENMASTER-DRUNK.title: Drunk
DRUNKENMASTER-DRUNK.description: [blue]8[/blue] or more [gold]Intoxication[/gold]. Still Tipsy, and your cards get random costs each turn.
DRUNKENMASTER-BLACKOUT.title: Blackout
DRUNKENMASTER-BLACKOUT.description: [blue]12[/blue] [gold]Intoxication[/gold]. At the end of your turn: play cards off the top of your draw pile, [gold]Exhaust[/gold] your hand, sober up, and wake [gold]Hungover[/gold].
